title: Eldritch Drift: Karting, but make it Lovecraft
author: Eldritch-Ostrich
selftext:
Here's a lil side project I've been working on lately! Eldritch Drift is a cartoon-goth kart racer with a PS2-era look, made in Godot 4.6. You drift, forge runes into spells, and earn favor with three old gods. Earn enough and a god wakes up, fills the track with traps, and turns the race into its own mode (the Hour's Coil, the Destroyer's Mark or the Path of Paths). Up to 4 players can race in local split-screen.

How AI was used:

\- Code: Claude Code wrote nearly all of it. That covers gameplay, bots, shaders, HUD and menus, plus the Blender Python scripts that build the tracks, props and gods. For art passes it ran subagents with a separate "critic" agent. The critic scored screenshots and sent work back until it held up.

\- Racers: the six drivers and their karts are Meshy models. A Blender script cuts the wheels out so they can spin, and the game animates the rig.

\- Audio: the music is generated in code (numpy synthesis, no AI music model). Engine sounds and voices are CC0/CC-BY clips from Freesound.

\- Translations: 8 languages, machine translated.

\- Me: design, direction, playtesting and a lot of "that looks wrong, try again".

The video was captured in-engine, not made with AI video tools.

Try the demo and wishlist here: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5501270](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5501270)
